reference.title: Firefox policy reference topic template
reference.shortdesc: Template for generated and reviewed Firefox Policy Guide reference topics.

section.title: Purpose
section.p: Explain what the Firefox policy controls at runtime and why a BPM user would configure it.

section.title: BPM location
section.p: Identify the BPM UI target, section, support level, and widget used to configure or inspect the policy.

section.title: Value shape
section.p: Describe the JSON value type, nested fields, arrays, dictionaries, required fields, and unknown-field preservation rule.

section.title: Release and ESR support
section.p: State whether the policy is available in Firefox ESR 140.12, Firefox Release 152, both channels, or only one channel.

section.title: Examples
section.p: Provide a channel-valid Firefox policies.json example or a reviewed no-example marker.

section.title: Validation
section.p: Document accepted values, required fields, common validation errors, and the affected policy path shown by BPM.

section.title: Caveats
section.p: Capture deployment caveats, schema caveats, raw fallback behavior, and unsupported-channel behavior.

section.title: Interactions
section.p: List related policies, managed preferences, conflicts, overrides, and handoff points to user tasks.

section.title: CIS links
section.p: Link mapped CIS recommendations, levels, and manual-review states without copying restricted benchmark prose.

section.title: Provenance
section.p: Record schema source, Mozilla version, schema version, inventory revision, schema hash, and review status.
